Smart Sensor Monitoring System
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program to simulate a Smart Sensor Monitoring System.

The system must demonstrate:

Use of static data members

Use of a volatile object

A member function declared with the volatile qualifier

Proper class design with user input

System Description

Each sensor records temperature readings.

You must:

Track total number of sensors created (using a static member)

Allow reading temperature from a volatile object

Provide functionality to update and display readings

Requirements
1️⃣ Create a class Sensor
🔒 Private Data Members:

int sensorID

double temperature

static int totalSensors

Public Member Functions:

Constructor

Assign sensor ID and temperature

Increment totalSensors

void updateTemperature(double temp)

Update temperature value

double getTemperature() const volatile

Return temperature

Must be callable on a volatile object

static int getTotalSensors()

Return total number of sensors created

Input Format
sensorID temperature
newTemperature

Output Format
Initial Temperature: <value upto 2 decimal places>
Updated Temperature: <value upto 2 decimal places>
Total Sensors Created: <count>
